correctness.rationale: The exact identities M^3=I+2M and M^6=5I+8M yield the binomial interpolation G_r(t)=5^{-t}U_{6t+r}; the first j=1 difference term has precisely 2-adic valuation 3+nu2(z-w), every higher term at least 5+nu2(z-w). Hence G_r is a scaled isometry and its image is U_r+8Z_2; finite-residue bijections prove existence and uniqueness of tau when 8|U_r, and U_r=4 mod8 gives bounded valuation exactly 2. Modulo-2 period-three and M^6 mod4 produce the other five classes; the coefficient-parity involution proves 24 of 48 initial pairs per case. Independently enumerated 48 primitive mod-8 pairs, verifying all six low classes and modular uniqueness through level 11. This is an infinite proof plus finite corroboration, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: The complete exact divisibility-index valuation tree for every Fibonacci-type starting pair is a natural generalization of Fibonacci/Lucas p-adic valuations. It identifies a rigid unique 2-adic lifting branch, sharp modular densities and a transparent bounded/unbounded dichotomy, facts useful to recurrence divisibility and p-regularity studies.
